subject.title: [Bug]: macOS app onboards an already configured connected Gateway

question: Should the protected maintainer-labeled macOS onboarding regression be fixed as a narrow launch-routing bug now?
rationale: The bug is source-supported, but the protected `maintainer` label means cleanup automation should not close or queue a repair without maintainer intent.

options.title: Fix the launch routing now
options.body: Add a narrow macOS fix that skips onboarding only after configured Gateway connectivity succeeds and covers the unset-marker case with focused Swift tests.

options.title: Defer into broader macOS onboarding work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical regression while a maintainer folds it into a larger onboarding cleanup branch.

recommendation.title: Fix the launch routing now
recommendation.body: Add a narrow macOS fix that skips onboarding only after configured Gateway connectivity succeeds and covers the unset-marker case with focused Swift tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent macOS Gateway setup implementation and adjacent macOS app work both route to this handle in the available history.
